title: ConfigError: use thiserror instead of manual Display+Error impl
description: reader/config.rs and imap/config.rs both define a ConfigError enum that manually impl Display and std::error::Error by hand. The project already uses thiserror (see stoa_auth::CredentialStoreError). Manual impls are maintenance burden with no benefit — #[derive(thiserror::Error)] + #[error(...)] attributes would produce identical behaviour with less code and consistent style. Callers who match on ConfigError variants are unaffected; the change is mechanical.
